Introduction

CRAVITY is a 9 member boy group that combines "Creativity" and "Gravity" with a team name that implies bringing you into their universe with their unique charm. CRAVITY, which stands for "CenteR of grAVITY," also has a goal of achieving the best performance by having a perfect balance when different types of members come together.

The 9 members are: Serim, Allen, Jungmo, Woobin, Wonjin, Minhee, Hyeongjun, Taeyoung and Seongmin.

The group is under Starship Entertainment, and debuted on April 14, 2020 with the mini album "HIDEOUT : REMEMBER WHO WE ARE".

On June 2, 2025, it was reported that CRAVITY would be releasing their second full-length album later that month. On June 4, the group unveiled a logo motion video for the upcoming release, Dare to Crave, which is scheduled to drop on June 23. Alongside the comeback, leadership responsibilities will be shared by members Wonjin and Hyeongjun.

As an addition, CRAVITY redefined the meaning of their name to represent “Craving Gravity,” symbolizing their aim to attract and captivate fans with an even stronger presence and artistic growth. This new interpretation reflects the group’s evolving identity and their commitment to drawing fans closer through their music and performances.
